Agenda #1: The meeting approved the 2025 Annual Report and ratified the consolidated financial statements for the year ending December 31, 2025. It also granted a full discharge of liability to the Board of Directors and Board of Commissioners for their management and supervision during that period.
Agenda #2: Shareholders approved the proposed allocation and use of the company's net profit earned during the 2025 fiscal year.
Agenda #3: The meeting approved the appointment of an independent auditor for the 2026 financial year and authorized the Board of Commissioners to set the associated honorarium.
Agenda #4: The meeting approved changes to the company's leadership, confirming a board structure with Adrianto Djokosoetono as President Director and Bayu Priawan Djokosoetono as President Commissioner. The terms of office for the board members were set to end in 2028 or 2029.
Agenda #5: Shareholders approved the determination of remuneration and benefits for the members of the company's Board of Directors and Board of Commissioners.
